items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: I mean with Trio Globo, Gene and Glen are very inspiring players and composers, and so that group is a very – it’s like a group of three equals and we all are inspired by each other and write things for each other.

ctx.x: Yeah. How did you learn about the – all the things you need to know about ranges and what instruments can do well and not so well. Like basically orchestration. Did you teach yourself?

Yeah. And just also from knowing how to play a lot of instruments, that kind of helps. You know I can play clarinet and flute and I know what the oboe is and I know what the range of trumpets are. I mean I’ve played with trumpet players for years, and trombone, and I know what these things sound like you know. I don’t really write out of range. And I do play mandolin and my ex-girlfriend was a violinist, and so I know, I mean I’m a pretty good mandolin player so I’m not going to write unplayable things for…
Speaking of Trio Globo I wanted to compliment you on the tune “Steering by the Stars.”
